name: Solana account rent as raw storage
aliases: Solana account rent as raw storage

card.provider: Solana account rent as raw storage
card.summary: No free tier. Storage is a refundable rent-exempt deposit: 10 MiB account costs 53,268,311,040 lamports (~53.27 SOL) to create, reclaimed only on close.

record.provider: Solana account rent as raw storage

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Storage is a refundable rent-exempt deposit: 10 MiB account costs 53,268,311,040 lamports (~53.27 SOL) to create, reclaimed only on close.

egress.terms: Free reads via RPC while the account exists; all RPC providers rate-limit or block bulk account-data reads.

record.tooling: Solana JSON-RPC (getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption, getAccountInfo), solana-sdk, Anchor. Wrapper examples exist but nothing production-grade for bulk file storage.
record.chaining: Cost scales linearly with bytes at ~5 SOL/MiB; 1 TiB would need ~5.3 million SOL of locked capital. Sharding across wallets does not reduce the deposit.
record.limits_note: Rent-exempt deposit per byte; per-transaction size cap means large accounts are written in many transactions; account data is public and account creation is rate-limited/expensive.

evidence.proved: probe: POST solana-rpc.publicnode.com getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption([10485760]) -> result 53268311040 lamports for a 10 MiB account
'Accounts must hold a minimum lamport balance proportional to their data size to stay onchain'
rent is reclaimable in full when the account is closed
